Module network.ike.examples.hl7ig.ingest

module network.ike.examples.hl7ig.ingest

Ingest module — HL7 IG-publisher bundle normalizer.

Converts upstream IG-publisher output bundles into AsciiDoc topic fragments under the corpus topics/ext/standards/{ig-id}/ directory.
